meta.name: remove-deadcode
meta.description: Remove unused code from this project with ultrawork mode, LSP-verified safety, atomic commits. Triggers: remove dead code, dead code, cleanup, remove unused.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动移除项目中未使用的代码，保证安全并生成原子提交
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果项目积累了大量死代码需要安全清理
copy.tagline_en: Automatically remove unused code with safety and atomic commits
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your project has accumulated dead code that needs safe removal

howto.what: Claude 会扫描项目里没人引用的代码，用 LSP 查引用逐一确认，再按文件分批交给并行子代理删除并逐个提交。它自己只负责扫描、验证、分派，不直接改代码。
howto.when: 当你提到「删除死代码」「cleanup」等关键词时触发。也可附带文件路径、目录或符号名来缩小扫描范围，不写则默认全项目扫描。

say.text: 帮我清理这个项目里的死代码
say.note: 全项目扫描，确认无人引用后分批删除并提交

say.text: 只清理 src/utils 下的未使用代码
say.note: 把扫描范围限定在该目录

say.text: 列出所有没人引用的导出符号，先别删
say.note: 只给确认清单，不做删改

howto.what_en: Claude scans for unreferenced code, confirms each item with LSP reference lookups, batches removals by file, and delegates them to parallel agents that commit atomically.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention removing dead code, dead code, or cleanup. You can add a file path, directory, or symbol name to narrow the scan; otherwise it scans the whole project.

say_en.text: Clean up the dead code in this project
say_en.note: Full scan; confirmed items are removed and committed

say_en.text: Only clean unused code under src/utils
say_en.note: Limits the scan to that directory

say_en.text: List unreferenced exported symbols but don't remove yet
